title: Brush round-nib sub-pixel residuals: 1-twip-apart independent passes + faceInteriorPoint candidate-selection band (from 1434/1435)
description: BOTH residuals FIXED (not accepted-limitations) with minimal kernel changes; all it.fails promoted to regular passing cases in brush-round-parity.test.ts. (a) loop h=2/sp=2 (~7px2): root cause was NOT missing snap-rounding per se — the task-1335 shared-vertex guard in arrangement.ts insertEdge suppressed a GENUINE transversal crossing at (62,45.1956) because the snapped hit lay within 1.5 twips of an endpoint of BOTH edges; but those endpoints were two DISTINCT points 1 twip apart ((62,45.2) leg corner vs (62.05,45.2) arm silhouette endpoint), not a shared vertex. The suppressed split left a 1-twip slit through which the enclosed-hole face leaked into the covered band (face 24 spanned hole + band; one interior sample -> whole band null). Fix: sharedEndpointTouch() — the guard now requires the near endpoints to have the SAME pointKey (a real shared vertex; true tangent touches always satisfy this since consecutive path segments share their vertex exactly by construction). The registered split then canonicalizes onto the existing vertex (1435 hot-pixel pull), sealing the junction. (b) walk seed=2 h=9 (0.5px2): faceInteriorPoint's grid stage returned a candidate lying EXACTLY on the dart face's boundary line (fp coin-toss inside), inside the <=0.02px band vs the source-region chord -> face classified null. Fix: candidates (centroid->grid->diagonal, same preference order) must clear the flattened face boundary by INTERIOR_CLEARANCE = 1 twip; thinner-than-2-twip faces fall back to the max-clearance interior candidate (never worse than old first-hit, still provably interior). EVIDENCE: full ordered build exit 0; pnpm --filter @flash/core test -- --run => Test Files 358 passed, Tests 5882 passed / 2 skipped / 0 failed (no oracle/property/eraser/paint-bucket/subselection regression); brush-round-parity.test.ts 30/30 incl. the mandated 1434 matrix (loop x half{4,8} x spacing{3,8,14}, caps, dabs, circle fidelity) still 0-defect and the two promoted residual cases; @flash/authoring-ui 118 files / 1311 tests all green. Docs updated: docs/36 s3.0i (guard refinement) + former-residuals block; docs/04 round-nib bullet.
